title: 단수·복수 주의할 명사 (jeans / people / news)
goal: jeans, people, news처럼 헷갈리는 명사에 맞는 동사(is / are)를 쓰고, a pair of로 셀 수 있어요.

points.title: 두 부분으로 된 물건은 항상 복수
points.body: jeans(청바지), shorts(반바지), trousers(바지), glasses(안경), sunglasses(선글라스), scissors(가위)는 다리나 날이 두 개라서 항상 복수예요. 그래서 동사도 are를 써요. My jeans are new.

points.title: 하나는 a pair of
points.body: 이런 물건 하나를 말할 때는 a jeans (X)가 아니라 a pair of jeans(청바지 한 벌)라고 해요. a pair of sunglasses, two pairs of shorts.

points.title: people과 police는 복수
points.body: people(사람들)은 person의 복수형이고, police(경찰)도 복수로 써요. 그래서 is가 아니라 are예요. People are friendly here. The police are here.

points.title: -s로 끝나도 단수인 명사
points.body: news(뉴스)와 maths(수학)는 -s로 끝나지만 하나로 취급해서 is를 써요. The news is on at six.

points.title: 단수와 복수가 같은 명사
points.body: sheep(양), fish(물고기)는 하나든 여러 마리든 모양이 같아요. one sheep, ten sheep / one fish, five fish.

formula: a pair of + jeans / shorts / glasses / scissors
news / maths + is · sheep, fish: 단수 = 복수

mistakes.why: 청바지는 한 벌이어도 jeans가 복수형이라 are를 써요.

mistakes.wrong: The people is very friendly here.
mistakes.right: The people are very friendly here.
mistakes.why: people은 이미 '사람들'이라는 복수라서 is가 아니라 are예요.

mistakes.right: I bought a pair of jeans.
mistakes.why: jeans 앞에 a를 바로 붙일 수 없어요. 한 벌은 a pair of jeans예요.

examples.en: These jeans are too long for me.
I bought a pair of sunglasses for the beach.
People in Australia are really friendly.
The police are at the train station.
The news is on TV at six.
There are hundreds of sheep on this farm.
examples.ko: 이 농장에는 양이 수백 마리 있어요.

examples.en: My shorts are wet from the rain.

quiz.why: 두 부분으로 된 옷 하나는 a pair of

quiz.sentence: The police ___ looking for the driver.

quiz.why: 가위는 항상 scissors. a를 바로 붙이지 않아요.

quiz.answer: I caught five fish at the beach.
choices: I caught five fish at the beach.
I caught five fishs at the beach.
I caught five a fish at the beach.
I caught five fishies at the beach.
A people are waiting in line.
quiz.why: people은 복수 → are, a를 붙이지 않아요.

quiz.answer: The people at my work are nice.
choices: The people at my work are nice.
The people at my work is nice.
The peoples at my work is nice.
The person at my work are nice.

quiz.answer: I need a pair of new shorts.
choices: I need a pair of new shorts.
I need a pair of new short.
I need a pair new shorts.
quiz.why: 반바지 한 벌은 a pair of + shorts

choices: A maths is my favourite subject.
